provenance: The 42 stage-1 survivors of the 2026-10-02 intelligence-pipeline run, read from the settled day file _pipeline/vault-derived/memory/feeds/intel-2026-10-02.jsonl on 2026-10-02 (backlog #2081). Rows are FeedItem-shaped: the scoring output (relevance / why / grade_source) is stripped, because this file is the day's INPUT — replaying it must re-derive who the call budget asks, not read back who it asked. Row order is the order the day file holds them, which is the order the day's scan passes appended them: state.save_raw_items opens the raw file "a" (state.py:77), and each pass contributes its own block with that pass's GitHub rows in github-repos.yml order ahead of its videos in feed order. The two items that run never graded (grade_source=call_cap) were the last two rows of the last pass and so of the file, both YouTube videos, while 21 of the 40 grades fell below vault_writer.RELEVANCE_FLOOR=4 and wrote nothing. report_as_run holds that run's own scoring report, read from the day witness committed at backlog/data/intel-2026-10-02.jsonl on the vault's main (1bdb798cb), which is the surface #2081's numbers are quoted from.
